was: 110 extremely well-maintained gravel RV sites on restored tallgrass prairie.  ~55 electric and ~55 full-hookup.  Reservable online or at gate until 11pm, technically no FCFS.  2-night minimum on regular weekends, relaxed within 3 days of arrival.  3-night minimum on holiday weekends, relaxed only for nights that have already passed.  $16 out-of-state vehicle fee charged upon arrival at the park in addition to campground fee.  RV Life 5*/$$ but note that tax/fees can push into $$$ range. --AWH (9/2026)

was:
Venango County park (2,695 acres) on 144-acre Justus Lake near Franklin PA. Drive-in RV camping: 12 full-hookup + 28 electric sites (30/50-amp), modern showers, dump station, camp host. The lakeside 'water's edge' sites (loops E/F) are walk-in/primitive tent sites; the RV loops are set back east of the lake, so waterfront none. Reservations via the park office. --Claude
MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on reservations; first-come sites take one night (twomilerun.net camping page, read 2026-10-20). --Claude

was: Family campground at 251 Hodgson Rd near Darlington (Beaver Co), close to the PA Turnpike and the Ohio line. Full-hookup RV sites with 20/30/50-amp metered electric, back-in and pull-through, for rigs to 45 ft, plus water/electric and pop-up sites and primitive tent sites; nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays. Hot showers, flush toilets, saltwater pool, catch-and-release fishing pond (RV sites not confirmed pond-front), Wi-Fi near the office. Open April 15 - October 15. Book online through Campspot or by phone. RV Life 4★, price $$ (2/4). --Claude
